decks.notes: The deck focuses on using control elements like Cabal Therapy and Duress to disrupt opponents while utilizing Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures. The deck includes a variety of utility creatures with abilities that can provide additional value or disruption, alongside cards like Recurring Nightmare for recursion. The mana base is designed to support the diverse range of spells and creatures in the deck. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through efficient creature selection and disruptive elements.

The main idea of this deck is to put constant pressure on the opponent using low-cost, efficient creatures and burn spells. By quickly reducing the opponent's life total, the deck aims to win before the opponent can stabilize or gain control of the game. The use of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, along with aggressive creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, allows the deck to maintain a fast pace and punish any slow starts from the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Price of Progress also adds additional reach and damage potential.

This Elf aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with creatures like Llanowar Elves and Priest of Titania, while using cards like Wirewood Symbiote to untap them for even more mana. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Deranged Hermit and Multani's Acolyte to overwhelm the opponent. Survival of the Fittest helps tutor for key creatures, while Tangle Wire and Anger provide disruption and control. The deck aims to flood the board with elves and use its mana advantage to overpower the opponent quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing enchantments, particularly those that draw cards or provide additional resources, in order to create a powerful combo that overwhelms the opponent. By leveraging the power of enchantress effects and cards that interact with enchantments, the deck aims to establish a solid defense with cards like Solitary Confinement and Elephant Grass while setting up the win condition with cards like Opalescence and Sacred Mesa. The deck also includes cards like Replenish and Sterling Grove to help maintain consistency and protect key pieces of the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a unique combination of cards that allows for explosive plays and deck manipulation. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Quiet Speculation, Deep Analysis, and Circular Logic to control the game and find key pieces. Additionally, the deck includes powerful creatures like Meddling Mage, Tireless Tribe, and Wild Mongrel to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also has access to removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Roar of the Wurm to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently execute its game plan and overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources while ramping up mana quickly with cards like Mox Diamond and utilizing land destruction with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port. Oath of Druids is used as a win condition to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore. Other control elements such as Sphere of Resistance and Pyroclasm help to keep the opponent's threats in check. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence and ultimately winning through powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to use cards like Attunement and Intuition to quickly fill up the graveyard with enchantments, then use Replenish to bring them all back onto the battlefield. Opalescence turns these enchantments into creatures for added pressure, while cards like Parallax Wave and Tide provide control and removal options. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and disruption, utilizing the combo potential of various enchantments to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle using low-cost creatures and burn spells. By constantly applying pressure and dealing direct damage to the opponent, the deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, the deck includes cards that can help maintain a steady stream of damage and prevent the opponent from gaining life or stabilizing, allowing for a quick and decisive victory.

The deck focuses on using cycling cards and control spells to manage the board and disrupt the opponent's strategies. By cycling through cards like Slice and Dice and Renewed Faith, as well as utilizing cards like Astral Slide and Lightning Rift, the deck can control the tempo of the game and generate incremental advantage over time. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Humility and Wrath of God helps to clear the board when necessary, while cards like Eternal Dragon provide a powerful late-game threat. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the synergy and speed of Goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive tactics. By using cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat out powerful Goblin creatures early, while also having disruptive elements like Gempalm Incinerator and Goblin Sharpshooter to control the board, this deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence and deal damage efficiently. With the support of mana acceleration from Skirk Prospector and disruption from cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port, this deck seeks to maintain pressure and close out games swiftly.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to put pressure on early, as well as cards like Goblin Piledriver and Goblin Warchief to boost the power of your Goblins, this deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of removal spells like Smother and Gempalm Incinerator helps to control the opponent's board while maintaining the aggressive strategy. Additionally, cards like Siege-Gang Commander provide additional reach and closing power to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to maintain board control and disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck aims to establish a lock on the game by using cards like Standstill and Humility to slow down the opponent's momentum while slowly building up its own resources. The inclusion of cards like Seal of Cleansing and Decree of Justice also allows the deck to handle threats efficiently while maintaining a steady mana base through lands like Mishra's Factory and Flooded Strand.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy by utilizing cards like Sphere of Resistance, Pyroclasm, and Stone Rain. Oath of Druids is used to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore, while Sylvan Library provides card advantage. The deck also includes land destruction spells like Wasteland and resource denial with Rishadan Port to slow down the opponent's game plan. By establishing board control and limiting the opponent's resources, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle combo to create a powerful threat on the battlefield. By utilizing counterspells and card draw spells, the deck aims to protect the combo pieces and ensure a smooth execution of the strategy. With a focus on control and disruption, the goal is to outmaneuver the opponent and secure a victory through a well-timed and efficient combo.

This deck focuses on using multiple control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while simultaneously utilizing Survival of the Fittest to tutor for and recur key creatures from the graveyard. By combining disruptive cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress with powerful creatures like Genesis and Deranged Hermit, the deck aims to out-value and outlast the opponent in a grindy game. The inclusion of various utility creatures like Nantuko Vigilante and Uktabi Orangutan provides additional answers to opposing threats, making it a versatile and resilient control deck.

The deck focuses on quickly playing creatures and disrupting the opponent's hand with discard spells. Using cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress, the deck aims to control the game while utilizing Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures like Arrogant Wurm and Krovikan Horror. Zombie Infestation is used to generate a constant stream of tokens, while cards like Birds of Paradise and Wild Mongrel help ramp up mana production. The deck also includes removal and options for disruption, creating a fast-paced and aggressive playstyle.
